topic: C1 - training-range collapse in adaptive domain randomization
summary: Six adaptive DR runs (two controller variants x three seeds, 8,000 iterations each) all applied reductions to their own difficulty scale, and two ended near zero (final lambda 0.062416 and 0.012064) after having reached the full envelope within the first 70 iterations; a matched never-shrink control applied zero reductions across three runs while refusing 2,033 requests. The collapse is invisible from inside training and inverted on the ladder: the two collapsed runs hold the two highest terminal returns of the twelve scored arm-seed pairs (15.29 and 14.40 against 10.98-12.28 for every run that held), and terminal return versus frontier success AUC has Spearman -0.7343 over n=12 (Pearson -0.6095 overall, -0.5977 over the nine controller arms). The preregistered collapse scores 0.739909 frontier success AUC against 0.881836 for fixed DR and 0.913086 for never-shrink on the same seed, i.e. -14.19 and -17.32 points, while its in-envelope AUC is still 0.998047. That readout was frozen before it existed (git c9ccedb at 14:10 EDT; measurement manifest at 16:17 EDT) and landed inside the recency prediction interval, below the uniform interval, and 14.19 points below the 'evacuation is free' comparator, so 'the collapse is cosmetic' is rejected while 'recency-weighted exposure' remains unearned. Two scope limits travel with all of this: a 7.8-point between-seed effect measured on the two lambda-pinned arms, about 4x the exposure law's own 1.83-point residual SD, so the law must not be quoted without a seed term; and the friction clamp at phys_150 (static-friction floor 0.1375 -> 0.05, 2.75x, carrying a third of the endpoint weight) is where all four Phase-0 adaptive arms take their largest drop, with foot-slip growth ordering the drops on n=4, correlational evidence only.

NO PREREGISTERED DEFINITION OF 'COLLAPSE'. No receipt states a numeric threshold separating 'shrank' from 'collapsed'. The operational definition in use is 'terminal lambda near 0 after having reached lambda = 1.0'. Both collapsed runs also spend hundreds of iterations below lambda 0.05 mid-run, and one range-holding run (lucid_s4_rg@s8601) applied 1,273 decreases and still ended at lambda 1.0. The paper must state the definition it uses in one sentence.

DENOMINATOR HYGIENE: '2 of 6' pools two DIFFERENT adaptive variants (lucid_rg, lucid_s4_rg) across three seeds, and the two collapses fall on different variants and different seeds (lucid_rg@s8601, lucid_s4_rg@s8600). It is not two replicates of one curriculum failing, and it is not a 1/3 rate estimated from six exchangeable runs.
